name: bkit
description: Classical machine learning for Bantu: scikit-learn's shape, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting implementation inside it rather than beside it. Phases K1-K5 of twelve: the estimator protocol, Pipeline with step__param addressing, eleven preprocessing transformers, model selection, metrics, and linear models -- LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, LogisticRegression (binary IRLS, multiclass one-vs-rest) and mini-batch SGD. No model forms X'X: the Gram matrix squares the condition number, so every fit goes through lstsq on the design matrix.
